description: This file appears to be a shell script for testing and managing Subversion (SVN) repositories and integration with Git, including setup, environment checks, and utility functions related to SVN and Perl SVN libraries.

methods.name: poke
methods.description: Adjusts the modification time of a specified file to trigger change detection.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: Constructs and executes an SVN command with optional configuration directory.

methods.name: maybe_start_httpd
methods.description: Attempts to start an HTTP daemon for SVN if environment variables permit.

methods.name: convert_to_rev_db
methods.description: Converts raw record data into an SVN revision database format using Perl.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Checks if svnserve is enabled via environment variable, skips tests if not.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts an svnserve daemon on a specified port with the given repository root.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Sets up UTF-8 locale environment for tests if available.
